title: Logistics Coordinator
description: Official Rawabi Archer logistics role in Dammam focused on coordinating transportation and distribution for company operations. The role covers receiving and distributing work orders and communications, determining personnel and vehicle needs, scheduling dispatch to and from job sites, monitoring equipment and tool availability, handling client and site inquiries, maintaining document archives, recording equipment movements, coordinating with drivers and transport vendors, and improving logistics procedures. The listing asks for proven logistics coordination, dispatching, or operations-management experience, with 5 to 6 years shown in the preferred-candidate section.
